character.alt: A full-body pixel art field cartographer with a satchel and practical exploration gear.

specification.visualIdentity: Welcoming top-down adventure pixel art with practical landmarks, open routes, and calm exploration as the dominant visual read.
specification.pixelTechnique: Use crisp native-resolution pixel clusters without antialiasing, one-pixel material-colored contours, selective internal outlines, and two or three deliberate shade steps per material.
specification.shapeLanguage: Favor clear asymmetrical silhouettes, breathable clusters, broad primary paths, compact secondary details, and off-center landmarks over perfect symmetry or enclosed arenas.
specification.paletteAndLighting: Use fresh greens, clear blues, honey and walnut timber, warm gray stone, restrained terracotta, and pale golden daylight with short readable shadows cast down-right.
specification.characterDirection: Build clearly adult characters with natural anatomy, grounded practical poses, readable equipment, friendly neutral expressions, and silhouettes that remain distinct at thumbnail size.
specification.environmentDirection: Compose maps around immediately legible traversal hierarchy, multiple routes continuing beyond the frame, recognizable material zones, and useful landmarks with generous walkable space.
specification.propDirection: Construct props from simple readable masses, limited material palettes, and restrained highlights; each prop should communicate one gameplay purpose without decorative clutter.
specification.effectsDirection: Keep effects compact and rhythmic with a strong core shape, a limited frame-to-frame palette, and brief readable accents that do not obscure characters or traversal.
specification.uiHudDirection: Use compact pixel-aligned panels, high-contrast icons, plain readable labels, and restrained ornament; UI must remain legible without relying on the preview images.
specification.animationDirection: Animate with economical key poses, stable silhouettes, intentional holds, and consistent pixel volumes; avoid subpixel movement and automatic smoothing.
specification.accessibility: Maintain clear value separation between walkable terrain, obstacles, characters, and interaction targets; never rely on hue alone, and avoid flicker, generated text, horror, gore, or uncanny anatomy.
